methodology.prDetection: Compares your latest section time against all previous efforts to detect personal records.
methodology.sectionTrend: Tracks median performance on frequently visited sections over time.
methodology.periodComparison: Compares training metrics so far this week against the same point last week.
methodology.hrvDescription: The 7 calendar days ending today, with at least five HRV readings. The mean of the older half is compared with the newer half. A move counts only if its 95% interval, from the spread of your readings, excludes zero and is larger than half a standard deviation of that spread and 2% of the older mean. Anything smaller reads as steady. A steady window still reads as falling if the last two readings fall on consecutive days, the second is lower, it sits below the window mean, and it passes the same test against earlier readings.
methodology.periodComparisonRestDay: Compares last week against your 4-week average when the current week has no activities yet.
methodology.ftpEstimation: Compares your latest daily eFTP with the value from 30 days earlier. eFTP is intervals.icu's estimate from your power curve, not the FTP setting on your account.
methodology.criticalSpeedDescription: Compares your latest critical speed, from the 42-day pace curve, with the most recent value in the previous 90 days that differs by more than 0.02 m/s. The change is shown as pace.
methodology.efficiencyDescription: Tracks average heart rate times pace across matched efforts on the section, as a least squares trend over time. A direction is shown only when the trend's 95% interval excludes zero and the fitted change is more than 2% of the mean. A falling value means fewer heartbeats per km: a lower heart rate, a faster pace or both.
methodology.efficiencyFormula: {{quantity}} ({{unit}}) = average heart rate × pace (seconds per km)
methodology.route: Counts attempts on a route in one sport and direction that are timed, not excluded, not partial and inside the route's distance band. A record is the fastest of them, set recently. A trend compares the median of the last three against the three before, from six attempts.
